description: This Clustering repository holds code and supporting material for the PopClusters population and electrification study in sub-Saharan Africa. Its README points to the Scientific Data paper and methods for turning population and night-light inputs into settlement clusters. A modeller can inspect the preparation steps before using cluster polygons as demand zones in electricity access or rural-service simulations. The code cannot by itself verify household grid connections, and outputs depend on source population surfaces and night-light thresholds. GitHub reports GPL-3.0. I read the repository metadata and README without cloning code or reproducing the 44-country polygons. The related PopClusters Mendeley deposit is reviewed separately; its data rights are not inferred from the GPL code licence. No exact catalogue software record was found.
